desc: 背格架加双长抽的写字台配布面扶手椅，浅灰书房一整套
leaf: 书桌椅套装（带后背开放格架与台面下双长抽的写字台 + 同套浅布面扶手椅；四支外撇圆收分腿，固定桌体；以实拍为准，非升降学习桌、非转角桌、非单人电脑桌）
name: 浅灰书房背格架双长抽书桌椅套装款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒交代这是写字台带后背开放格架与台面下双长抽、并且和布面扶手椅一整套带回家，用真实居家书房与椅子台灯的尺度让人代入自己家。
shots.textZone: upper-left block: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 stacked over 「{selling_point_2}」 in #2B3136, one solid cobalt #44608F label block 「{callout_1}」, two thin 1px square-bracket rule labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 斜俯过椅背拍出台面被纸张本子挤满、后背格架与双长抽却空着的日常状态，逼出下一屏的归位机制，全程不写功效话术也不用人物。
shots.textZone: upper-left quiet band: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136, one 1px hairline rule #C7D0DD running to a square-bracket label 「{callout_1}」 pointing at the empty lower shelf band

shots.intent: 同一正立面同框双栏，把摊满台面与物件收进双长抽和后背格架之后的净空台面并排，让人自己看出来回去哪，不写一句收纳量主张。
shots.textZone: one square-bracket label 「{callout_1}」 riding the left panel and 「{callout_2}」 the right, one centre seam headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136, one solid cobalt #44608F block 「{callout_3}」 at the seam foot

shots.intent: 正交侧剖一条线讲清后背格架两层、台面下长抽带、窄望板与外撇圆腿的关系和台面进深，是全页机制解释的核心一图。
shots.textZone: upper-right column: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136, then four labels inside thin 1px square-bracket corner rules 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」, each joined to its own part by a hairline rule ending in one small solid square in #44608F

shots.intent: 把这套桌椅放回一间真实有人住的居家书房，坐姿机位交代占地、腿部净空与椅桌关系，让首屏的口号落到能用的一天里。
shots.textZone: upper band: one solid cobalt #44608F label block 「{callout_1}」, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136 at 30pt over one regular-weight line 「{callout_2}」 at 14pt, one small filled square as the bullet

shots.intent: 正俯视一次摊平台面净空区、两条长抽与后背格架上下两层的分区节奏，用可核验的实拍替掉所有容量数字。
shots.textZone: lower rail: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136 at 26pt plus three labels inside thin 1px square-bracket corner rules 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 with hairline risers ending in small solid squares

shots.intent: 掠射微距把小圆金属钮、长抽缝隙、望板接缝与台面前沿封边做实，用看得见的做工替代一切等级、涂层与环保话术。
shots.textZone: two labels only: 「{callout_1}」 on a chalk card #F2F3F1 with a 1px hairline riser to the knob and 「{callout_2}」 to the front-rim edge banding, both inside thin 1px square-bracket corner rules

shots.intent: 贴地仰视把桌腿的截面收分与外撇、腿与望板交接、椅壳布面缝线和四支固定木腿一次看清，用可见结构替掉稳固与承重主张。
shots.textZone: upper-right band: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136 at 24pt over two square-bracket labels, 「{callout_1}」 to the leg-to-apron joint and 「{callout_2}」 to the chair shell seam line, each on a 1px hairline riser ending in a small solid square

shots.intent: 用一名匿名裁切的成年人坐在配套椅子里、膝部落在望板下、前臂落在台面上，让桌与椅的成套尺度可信，替掉任何尺寸数字与姿态功效话术。
shots.textZone: upper-left: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136 at 28pt, one solid cobalt #44608F block 「{callout_1}」, two square-bracket labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 risering to the knee line and the hutch lower shelf line

shots.intent: 把源页那两张空白色卡收成两张同角度同曝光的真实选配卡，让买家一步看完确实存在的配置差异并选定，不虚构任何色名。
shots.textZone: one section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2B3136 on the top hairline rail, then one label inside thin 1px square-bracket corner rules beneath each card reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, one small filled square as the only bullet

shots.intent: 以一盏亮着的台灯与一张只写占位行的参数卡收口全页，把源页那张空白参数表变成不虚构的落点并给一条明确行动指令。
